## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juan* Sòng-period treatise by **Pǔwēng Yìxiān** 朴翁義銛. The title is drawn from the famous bamboo-loving anecdote of [王徽之](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%BE%BD%E4%B9%8B) Wáng Huīzhī (Eastern Jìn): "*One cannot for a moment be without this lord*" (referring to bamboo, *cǐjūn* 此君 = "this lord"). The work uses this literary metaphor as the framing for a Tiāntái doctrinal-meditative discussion.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Yìxiān's productive period in the Sòng (c. 1100–1250).
